subject: POC Observability Plan - FinTechX
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Shah <amit@fintechx.com>, Priya Patel <priya.patel@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Observability Plan - FinTechX

Hi Amit / Priya -

Great to meet you both on the call this morning. Quick recap + proposed observability scope for the POC so we have alignment before kickoff: 

Scope (what Redwood will deliver during POC):
- Out-of-the-box dashboards (hosted in Redwood Console) for per-route and per-model metrics
- Distributed tracing (Jaeger-compatible) for end-to-end request flows
- Log export to your S3 staging bucket (compressed JSONL)
- Token-level cost breakdown and per-request unit economics
- Alerts for regressions on quality and latency

Success criteria (to validate at the end of POC):
1) P50 latency for targeted route < 220ms, P95 < 450ms under your expected staging load
2) 99.9% request success (no transport errors / model fallbacks) across 48h smoke run
3) Traces show end-to-end path for 95%+ of requests (instrumentation coverage)
4) Log export pipeline ingests to S3 and is readable in your analytics (first 7 days)

Evaluation plan & ownership:
- Redwood: provide dashboards, tracing pipeline, and assist with model/runtime configuration (Jordan)
- FinTechX: instrumentation on client side and staging access for export (Priya, owner)
- Marissa: POC success owner and commercial point of contact

Timeline (proposal):
- Week 0 (this week): confirm owners + access, kickoff meeting
- Week 1: instrumentation + log export setup
- Week 2: baseline runs and dashboard tuning
- Week 3: 48h smoke run and evaluation against success criteria

Attachments: observability-checklist.pdf (instrumentation checklist), poc-timeline.xlsx (detailed schedule).

Can you confirm Priya as your internal POC owner and that staging S3 + a test corpus will be available? If that looks good I’ll schedule a kickoff for Tue 2026-07-20 (10:00 AM PT).

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: POC Observability Plan - FinTechX

Hi Amit / Priya -

Thanks - answers inline and a bit more detail on the observability deliverables so your infra and engineering teams can scope work ahead of kickoff.

Tracing / instrumentation:
- Preferred approach: instrument with OpenTelemetry (lightweight) on your service edge so spans include client request -> gateway -> Redwood. If you’d rather not add SDKs, Redwood can instrument at the gateway layer for requests that pass through our proxy, but span granularity will be lower. Recommendation: OTEL for best coverage.

S3 access / IAM:
- We’ll provide a minimal IAM policy for a 'redwood-poc-uploader' role that allows PutObject on the specified prefix and ListBucket on the staging bucket. Please have your infra team create a role and provide either short-term creds or an S3 presigned URL plan. We’ll include the exact policy in the kickoff doc.

Dashboards & metrics (to be provisioned in Redwood Console):
- Per-route latency (P50/P95/P99) - broken out by model variant
- Request volume and concurrency
- Token cost / request and cumulative spend by route
- KV cache hit rate and cache size
- Model fallback rate (percentage of requests routed to fallback model)
- Error rate (transport + model errors) and common error messages

Log export & retention:
- Exports as compressed JSONL to S3, prefix: fintechx/poc/2026-07/
- Default retention in Redwood Console: 90 days for logs/traces for the POC (we can extend if needed; storage costs apply)

Evaluation plan & thresholds (example):
- Baseline: run 12h at expected staging QPS (your test corpus) to capture steady-state metrics
- Smoke run: 48h steady traffic at target QPS; success if P95 < 450ms, error rate < 0.1% and fallback rate < 0.5%
- Quality checks: we'll run a 500-sample prompt set and compare outputs against your acceptance criteria (Priya to share test corpus + quality expectations)

Deliverables by Redwood:
- Configured dashboards and alerting, trace collection, verified S3 export, and a short runbook for reproducing results.

Links: kickoff doc and artifacts are in the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-fintechx-poc

I’ll drop the IAM policy and a calendar invite for Tue 2026-07-20 10:00 AM PT.
